continuity.name: 1st Ranger Bn
continuity.note: Same values. Salerno: lands Maiori D-Day; Italy: arrives Naples T14 (Nov 4-6), removed T20. Historically with the 82nd into Naples 2 Oct, recommitted at Venafro 8-10 Nov (Blumenson, Salerno to Cassino (CMH 1969, archive.org SalernoToCassino) pp.165, 231; Starr, From Salerno to the Alps: a History of the Fifth Army (1948, archive.org FromSalernoToTheAlps) p.52).

continuity.name: 3rd Ranger Bn
continuity.note: Same values. Italy arrives Naples T20 (Nov 22-24), removed T27; historically at San Pietro 29 Nov and Hill 950 7-13 Dec (Blumenson, Salerno to Cassino (CMH 1969, archive.org SalernoToCassino) p.273; Starr, From Salerno to the Alps: a History of the Fifth Army (1948, archive.org FromSalernoToTheAlps) pp.66-67).

continuity.name: 4th Ranger Bn
continuity.note: Same values. Italy arrives Naples T12 (Oct 29-31), removed T22; historically crossed the Volturno 3 Nov to Cannavinelle Hill (Blumenson, Salerno to Cassino (CMH 1969, archive.org SalernoToCassino) p.222; Starr, From Salerno to the Alps: a History of the Fifth Army (1948, archive.org FromSalernoToTheAlps) p.51).

continuity.name: 128th Brigade, 46th Div
continuity.note: Salerno splits the brigade: 128 Bde(-) 3-5-3 + 5th Hampshires 2-2-3 = Italy 5-7-3 (back 3-5-3). Combine when both are on the map (or keep the split until the Italy phase).

continuity.name: 138th Brigade, 46th Div
continuity.note: Identical counter. Landed 9 Sept from 7 a.m. (Molony, The Mediterranean and Middle East vol. V (HMSO 1973, archive.org mediterranean-middle-east-vol-5) p.278-280).

continuity.name: 139th Brigade, 46th Div
continuity.note: Identical counter. Landed night 9/10 Sept (Molony, The Mediterranean and Middle East vol. V (HMSO 1973, archive.org mediterranean-middle-east-vol-5) p.280); Salerno T2.

continuity.name: 169th (Queen's) Brigade, 56th Div
continuity.note: 169 Bde(-) 3-5-3 + 2/6th Queen's 2-2-3 = Italy 5-7-3. Note the Salerno id BR-2-5Q is named 2/6 Queen's.

continuity.name: 201st Guards Brigade, 56th Div
continuity.note: Identical counter. Landed 9 Sept 7.15 a.m. in reserve (Molony, The Mediterranean and Middle East vol. V (HMSO 1973, archive.org mediterranean-middle-east-vol-5) p.278). Wikipedia 56th Div lists it "left 17 September 1943" (Joslen) yet it fought on Camino with 56 Div in Nov (Starr, From Salerno to the Alps: a History of the Fifth Army (1948, archive.org FromSalernoToTheAlps) p.52); treat as 56 Div throughout.

continuity.name: 40th RTR, 23rd Armd Bde
continuity.note: Same 3-2-5. The only 23 Armd Bde tank unit in the assault (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/23rd_Armoured_Brigade_(United_Kingdom)).

continuity.name: Royal Scots Greys
continuity.note: Same 3-2-5. Salerno formation "X Corps" (affiliated to 56 Div, earmarked for 23 Armd Bde: Molony, The Mediterranean and Middle East vol. V (HMSO 1973, archive.org mediterranean-middle-east-vol-5) p.276); Italy formation "23 Arm Bde". Use 23 Armd Bde.

continuity.name: 1st King's Dragoon Guards
continuity.note: Same 2-2-6 recon. Salerno: X Corps, arrives T16 (24 Sept); Italy: Independent, at start 2224 (Naples). A Sqn reached central Naples 09:30 1 Oct (Molony, The Mediterranean and Middle East vol. V (HMSO 1973, archive.org mediterranean-middle-east-vol-5) p.343; Salerno: American Operations from the Beaches to the Volturno (CMH Pub 100-7, archive.org Salerno_139) p.87).

continuity.name: 131st (Queen's) Lorried Infantry Brigade, 7th Armd Div
continuity.note: Identical 5-7-5. Expected ashore 15 Sept (Molony, The Mediterranean and Middle East vol. V (HMSO 1973, archive.org mediterranean-middle-east-vol-5) p.301).

continuity.name: 22nd Armoured Brigade, 7th Armd Div
continuity.note: 22 Armd Bde(-) 8-6-5 + 5 RTR 3-2-5 = Italy 11-8-5 (whose back is 8-6-5). Remnant differs: Salerno BR-REM-22 3-2-5 vs Italy BR-REM-22-7A 5-3-5.

continuity.name: 11th Hussars, 7th Armd Div
continuity.note: Same 2-2-6. Italy removes it T13 (Nov 1-3), ahead of the rest of the division.

continuity.name: 142nd Infantry, 36th Div
continuity.note: 142 RCT(-) 4-4-3 + 1/142 2-2-3 = Italy 6-6-3 (Italy back estimated). Italy: returns T17.

continuity.name: 179th Infantry, 45th Div
continuity.note: Identical 6-6-3. Landed 10 Sept (Blumenson, Salerno to Cassino (CMH 1969, archive.org SalernoToCassino) p.99). Italy: enters T2 reduced from S2 (in the grand game it is already on the map).

continuity.name: 157th Infantry, 45th Div
continuity.note: 157 RCT(-) 4-4-3 + 2/157 2-2-3 = Italy 6-6-3. Two battalions landed 10 Sept, the third on 15 Sept (Blumenson, Salerno to Cassino (CMH 1969, archive.org SalernoToCassino) p.100). Blumenson names the late one the 1st Bn, but 1/157 fought at the Tobacco Factory 11-13 Sept (Salerno: American Operations from the Beaches to the Volturno (CMH Pub 100-7, archive.org Salerno_139) pp.46, 57, 62) - the game's 2/157 is consistent with that.

continuity.name: 180th Infantry, 45th Div
continuity.note: Identical 6-6-3. Landed early 14 Sept (Salerno: American Operations from the Beaches to the Volturno (CMH Pub 100-7, archive.org Salerno_139) p.72).

continuity.name: 133rd Infantry (-), 34th Div
continuity.note: Identical 4-4-3 (the 2nd Bn stayed in Algiers; the 100th Bn replaced it: Blumenson, Salerno to Cassino (CMH 1969, archive.org SalernoToCassino) p.162).

continuity.name: 135th Infantry, 34th Div
continuity.note: Identical 6-6-3. Italy T4 arrival S2 is the same counter continuing.

continuity.name: 504th Parachute Infantry, 82nd Abn
continuity.note: 504 PIR(-) 3-4-3 + 3/504 2-2-3 = Italy 5-6-3. Stays in Italy when the 82nd leaves (Blumenson, Salerno to Cassino (CMH 1969, archive.org SalernoToCassino) p.186). Italy: Naples garrison, released T11.

continuity.name: 505th Parachute Infantry, 82nd Abn
continuity.note: Identical 5-6-3. Italy: Naples garrison, removed T19 (Nov 19-21).

continuity.name: 325th Glider Infantry, 82nd Abn
continuity.note: Identical 5-6-3. Italy: Naples garrison, removed T19. Co. G held Ischia (Blumenson, Salerno to Cassino (CMH 1969, archive.org SalernoToCassino) p.164).

continuity.name: 2nd Bn, 509th Parachute Infantry
continuity.note: Same 2-2-3. Salerno formation 82 Abn (attached), Italy Independent. Italy: arrives Naples T15, removed T28.

continuity.name: 751st Tank Bn
continuity.note: Same 3-2-5; VI Corps vs 3 Div. (Blumenson index lists it as "751st Tank Destroyer Battalion" p.197 - a slip.)

continuity.name: 756th Tank Bn
continuity.note: VALUES DIFFER: Salerno 3-2-5, Italy 2-2-5 (tank rating 2). Pick one.

onlySalerno.name: No. 2 Commando
onlySalerno.note: Landed Vietri 9 Sept; relieved 18 Sept and withdrawn to Sicily (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/No._2_Commando). Remove at GT5 (17-18 Sept).

onlySalerno.name: No. 41 (Royal Marine) Commando
onlySalerno.note: As No. 2 Commando: relieved 18 Sept, withdrawn to Sicily (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/No._2_Commando).

onlySalerno.name: 3rd Bn, 531st Engineer Shore Regt
onlySalerno.note: Beach engineers. Remove when the beaches close: American unloading at the Salerno beaches stopped 14 Oct (GT18) (Starr, From Salerno to the Alps: a History of the Fifth Army (1948, archive.org FromSalernoToTheAlps) p.35).

onlySalerno.name: 531 Shore Rgt beachhead (Red)
onlySalerno.note: Beachhead marker; remove with the beaches (14 Oct).

onlySalerno.name: 35 Beach Group
onlySalerno.note: Beachhead marker; X Corps still unloaded at Salerno in mid-Oct (Starr, From Salerno to the Alps: a History of the Fifth Army (1948, archive.org FromSalernoToTheAlps) p.35); remove when Naples supply rules start.

onlySalerno.name: 13th Brigade, 5th Div (Eighth Army)
onlySalerno.note: Not Fifth Army. Eighth Army enters from the south (Salerno T11/T12); hand to the Adriatic/Eighth Army OOB.

onlyItaly.name: 168/56 (56 Div)
onlyItaly.note: 168th (London) Brigade, back to 56th Div. Italy: arrives Naples T5 (Oct 9-10). Rejoined 56 Div 17 Oct 1943 per Joslen as quoted on https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/56th_(London)_Infantry_Division.

onlyItaly.name: 11K/23A (23 Arm Bde)
onlyItaly.note: 11th Bn KRRC, 23 Armd Bde motor battalion (in 23 Armd Bde OOB: Starr, From Salerno to the Alps: a History of the Fifth Army (1948, archive.org FromSalernoToTheAlps) p.477). Italy T17 at S1/S2; arrival date not checked.

onlyItaly.name: 9 Cmdo (Independent)
onlyItaly.note: No. 9 Commando. Italy: arrives Naples T31 (Dec 25-28). Raid north of the Garigliano mouth (Op. Partridge) night 29/30 Dec (Starr, From Salerno to the Alps: a History of the Fifth Army (1948, archive.org FromSalernoToTheAlps) p.71; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/No._9_Commando).

onlyItaly.name: 6/1A (1 Arm Div)
onlyItaly.note: 6th Armored Infantry, 1st Armored Div. Italy T13 Naples. The 1st Armored began arriving at Naples 28 Oct (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1st_Armored_Division_(United_States)) / mid-Nov (Starr, From Salerno to the Alps: a History of the Fifth Army (1948, archive.org FromSalernoToTheAlps) p.53); under Fifth Army 15 Nov (Blumenson, Salerno to Cassino (CMH 1969, archive.org SalernoToCassino) p.251); 6th Armd Inf went into the line about 31 Dec (Starr, From Salerno to the Alps: a History of the Fifth Army (1948, archive.org FromSalernoToTheAlps) p.71).

onlyItaly.name: 1 Arm Div (1 Arm Div)
onlyItaly.note: 1st Armored Div ASU; as 6/1A.

onlyItaly.name: 776 (34 Div)
onlyItaly.note: 776th TD Bn (34 Div). Italy T4 at S2; date not checked.

onlyItaly.name: 760 (34 Div)
onlyItaly.note: 760th Tank Bn (34 Div). Italy T12 Naples; date not checked.

onlyItaly.name: 755 (45 Div)
onlyItaly.note: 755th Tank Bn (45 Div). Italy T13 Naples; date not checked.

onlyItaly.name: 91 (Independent)
onlyItaly.note: 91st Cavalry Recon Sqn. Italy T9 Naples; date not checked.

onlyItaly.name: II Corps (II Corps)
onlyItaly.note: II Corps (Keyes). Took over the Mignano sector 18 Nov (Blumenson, Salerno to Cassino (CMH 1969, archive.org SalernoToCassino) p.251); Italy T17 (Nov 13-15).

onlyItaly.name: M1 (Independent)
onlyItaly.note: Heavy (8-inch) howitzer. Two 8-inch battalions first used in the last two weeks of Nov (Blumenson, Salerno to Cassino (CMH 1969, archive.org SalernoToCassino) p.256); Italy T18.

onlyItaly.name: 1 SSF (Independent)
onlyItaly.note: 1st Special Service Force. Reached Naples 17 Nov (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/First_Special_Service_Force); attached to II Corps 23 Nov (Blumenson, Salerno to Cassino (CMH 1969, archive.org SalernoToCassino) p.255); Monte la Difensa 2-3 Dec (Starr, From Salerno to the Alps: a History of the Fifth Army (1948, archive.org FromSalernoToTheAlps) p.64). Italy T19.

onlyItaly.name: 4/2M (2M Div)
onlyItaly.note: 4e RTM, 2e DIM. 2nd Moroccan Div began unloading at Naples 20 Nov (Blumenson, Salerno to Cassino (CMH 1969, archive.org SalernoToCassino) p.254, checked on the page image); relieved the 34th Div 8-13 Dec (Starr, From Salerno to the Alps: a History of the Fifth Army (1948, archive.org FromSalernoToTheAlps) p.71). Italy T23.

onlyItaly.name: 5/2M (2M Div)
onlyItaly.note: 5e RTM, 2e DIM; as above.

onlyItaly.name: 8/2M (2M Div)
onlyItaly.note: 8e RTM, 2e DIM; as above.

onlyItaly.name: 4MG/2M (2M Div)
onlyItaly.note: 4e Groupe de Tabors Marocains (goumiers) with 2e DIM (Starr, From Salerno to the Alps: a History of the Fifth Army (1948, archive.org FromSalernoToTheAlps) p.77 n.4); as above.

onlyItaly.name: 2M Div (2M Div)
onlyItaly.note: 2e DIM ASU; as above.

onlyItaly.name: I Mtr (I Mtr)
onlyItaly.note: 1st Italian Motorized Group. Under Fifth Army 31 Oct, training at Avellino and Limatola (Starr, From Salerno to the Alps: a History of the Fifth Army (1948, archive.org FromSalernoToTheAlps) p.53); bivouac near Capua 22 Nov (Blumenson, Salerno to Cassino (CMH 1969, archive.org SalernoToCassino) p.253); Monte Lungo 7-8 and 16 Dec (Starr, From Salerno to the Alps: a History of the Fifth Army (1948, archive.org FromSalernoToTheAlps) pp.67, 70). Italy T24 at S1. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italian_Co-belligerent_Army gives a 27 Nov formation date, which disagrees.)

onlyItaly.name: REM (British) A, 7th Armoured (7 Arm Div)
onlyItaly.note: 7th Armd motorized remnant (twin of BR-REM-A).

onlyItaly.name: REM (British) B, 7th Armoured (7 Arm Div)
onlyItaly.note: 7th Armd motorized remnant.

onlyItaly.name: REM (British) C, 7th Armoured (7 Arm Div)
onlyItaly.note: 7th Armd motorized remnant.

onlyItaly.name: 6/1A REM (1 Arm Div)
onlyItaly.note: 6th Armd Inf remnant.

onlyItaly.name: REM (French) A (2M Div)
onlyItaly.note: French remnant.

onlyItaly.name: REM (French) B (2M Div)
onlyItaly.note: French remnant.

turnMapping: grandTurn in arrivals/withdrawals is the grand turn containing the HISTORICAL date; salernoTurn/italyTurn are the games' own schedules. Use 2-day turns from 9 Sept to 10 Oct, then Italy '43's own track. Grand turn GT1 = 9-10 Sept, GT2 = 11-12 ... GT11 = 29-30 Sept, GT12 = Italy T1 (Oct 1-2) ... GT16 = Italy T5 (Oct 9-10, the last 2-day turn), GT17 = Italy T6 (Oct 11-13) ... GT43 = Italy T32 (Dec 29-31). So GT = ceil(SalernoTurn / 2) for September and GT = ItalyTurn + 11 from October: 43 turns. Italy's 1-10 Oct are already 2-day turns, so the turn length changes only once, at 11 Oct. Both games play German then Allied, so an arrival dated on either day of a 2-day turn enters in that turn's Allied phase. A unit dated on the turn's second day (e.g. the 180th, 505th and 2/509 on 14 Sept, in GT3) then arrives at most one day early; to avoid that, delay odd-turn Salerno arrivals by a turn (no more than one day late). Night drops (504th 13/14 Sept; 505th and 2/509 14/15 Sept) both fall in GT3 (13-14 Sept). Salerno schedule -> GT: T2 (45th Div 179/157, corps troops) GT1; T5 (504) GT3; T6 (180, 505, 2/509) GT3; T7 (2/157, 131 Bde) GT4; T8 (325, 3/504, 5 RTR; Avalanche scenario ends) GT4; T9 (756, 11H) GT5; T10 (30th Inf, 7AD ASU) GT5; T11 (22 Armd Bde; Eighth Army arrives at the south edge) GT6; T12 (7th Inf) GT6; T13 (15th Inf, 3 Div ASU) GT7; T14 (133rd, 100th; 16 Pz withdrawal) GT7; T16 (KDG) GT8; T18 (135th) GT9; T19 (168th) GT10; T20 (34 Div ASU) GT10; T22 (30 Sept) GT11. From GT12 on, Italy's 'arrive T1/T2/T4 at S1/S2' entries for the 46th Div, 167 Bde, 45th Div (179, 180, 645, 756), 100th Bn, 34th Div (135, 168, 34 ASU) and the 3 Div/7AD/46/56/corps ASUs are not reinforcements: they are the Salerno counters already on the joined map. Ignore them and keep the units where they stand. The genuinely new Italy arrivals keep their turns (+11): 168 Bde GT16, 91 Recon GT20, 4 Rgr GT23 (return), 760 GT23, 1 Armd/6 AIR + 755 GT24, 1 Rgr GT25, 2/509 GT26, II Corps + 11 KRRC + 36 Div GT28-29, M1 GT29, 1 SSF GT30, 3 Rgr GT31, 2 DIM GT34, I Mtr GT35, 9 Cdo GT42. Rangers, 2/509 and the 36th Div are on the map in September, but Italy '43 has them off it on 1 Oct. Either withdraw them to a 'refit' holding box at the historical date (Rangers 2 Oct after entering Naples; 36th to Army reserve from 20 Sept, GT6) and bring them back on their Italy turns, or leave them on the map as frozen until those turns. Italy's 1 Oct at-start hexes are a useful check on where the Salerno counters should be by GT11 (see positions1Oct), not a set-up to impose.
